title: 1 person. A 10-person team's output.
subtitle: The 7 AI tools a solo founder actually runs in 2026.

title: You don't hire anymore. You assemble a stack.
subtitle: Each tool below replaces a role that used to cost a salary. Total run cost: under $200 a month.

items.label: Claude
items.note: your strategist + writer. The thinking layer.

items.label: Cursor
items.note: your engineer. Plain English into shipped code.

items.label: Lovable or Bubble
items.note: your app builder. A real product, no code.

items.label: Gamma
items.note: your designer. Decks and sites from a prompt.

items.label: Clay
items.note: your SDR. Finds and enriches leads on autopilot.

items.label: n8n or Make
items.note: your ops. Automates the repetitive busywork.

items.label: Stripe
items.note: your finance team. Payments, billing, subscriptions.

title: Don't open all seven today.
body: Pick the one job you are worst at, the thing you avoid. Plug in that tool first. Get one role off your plate, then add the next.
tip: Claude for the writing you dread, or Stripe so you can finally get paid.

title: The org chart is optional now.
subtitle: What used to need ten people and a year now needs one person and a weekend. The barrier was never the team. It was knowing the stack.

title: Save this as your hiring plan.
subtitle: Open one tool today and replace your first role. Follow for the build-along.
